items.title: Submit certified degree certificate and transcript with translations
items.quote: Please send us officially certified copies of your bachelor's degree certificate and your transcript of records, together with certified German or English translations, so that they reach us by 24 August 2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date by which the certified documents and translations must physically arrive at the International Office: 24 August 2027. No period calculation is needed since the date is given directly. 24 August 2027 falls on a Tuesday, a normal business day in NRW, so no weekend/holiday adjustment applies. This is a receipt deadline (documents must 'reach' the university), not merely a dispatch deadline.
